NLTK averaged perceptron tagger implementation and English model data

Original implementation:
Copyright 2013 Matthew Honnibal

NLTK port and modifications:
Copyright 2015 The NLTK Project
Author: Long Duong

This module is a port of the TextBlob Averaged Perceptron Tagger.
Whisperstream distributes a modified, inference-only implementation and the
three English JSON model-data files. The modified implementation is identified
in src/whisperstream/speech/kokoro_frontend.py.
